services.desc: Whether you have a first-time swimmer or a competitive athlete, we've got something for everyone to splash about! Explore Private Lessons, including a Private Adaptive option, where your swimmer will have individually tailored one-on-one swim instruction, or Group Lessons, where your swimmer will join a class of 4-8 swimmers of the same age and level to participate in fun, engaging swim activities together. If your swimmer does not meet both the age and skill prerequisites for any group class, you may be a good fit for our private lessons! Ready to dive in? services.name: Self Defense
services.desc: Whether inspired by a swashbuckling blockbuster, or a dream of competing for gold at the Olympics, there is a place for everyone in the art of fencing. Classes will teach students the fundamentals of Epee fencing as well as bring them up to a competitive level if they so desire. Bring a water bottle. Students must wear closed toe shoes and pants that cover their entire legs (such as sweatpants). Students are required to have their own equipment by the end of their second month in the class. Before attending their first class, students must sign up for an access membership under the club Chico Fencing Center through USA fencing. It is $34 and lasts until the end of July 2026.
